[Thinking]
**Exploring Office Furniture**

I'm currently exploring well-established office furniture brands and their online presences. My focus is on identifying those with robust websites that showcase a diverse range of products, from ergonomic chairs to collaborative workspace solutions.

**Researching Furniture Options**

I'm delving into prominent office furniture manufacturers, meticulously examining their online platforms. My current effort is concentrated on pinpointing brands that feature extensive product catalogs, encompassing everything from ergonomic seating to modular collaborative spaces.

**Identifying Key Brands**

I am currently identifying leading office furniture manufacturers and examining their online portfolios. My immediate focus is on recognizing brands with substantial product lines, from ergonomic seating to modular collaborative spaces.

**Researching Top Brands**

I am continuing to refine my search by looking into prominent office furniture manufacturers. My current focus is on identifying brands with strong online presences that showcase a wide array of products, from ergonomic seating to collaborative workspace solutions.

**Finding Key Brands**

I am continuing to refine my search by looking into prominent office furniture manufacturers. My current focus is on identifying brands with strong online presences that showcase a wide array of products, from ergonomic seating to collaborative workspace solutions.

**Gathering Website Links**

I'm continuing to explore prominent office furniture manufacturers' online platforms, focusing on identifying brands with comprehensive product portfolios. My current effort involves collecting website URLs for companies ranging from ergonomic specialists to those offering modular workspace solutions.

**Gathering Key Brands**

I'm continuing to investigate leading office furniture manufacturers' online platforms, prioritizing brands with comprehensive product portfolios. My current focus involves collecting URLs for companies specializing in everything from ergonomic seating to modular collaborative solutions.
[/Thinking]

Of course! The world of office furniture is vast, so here is a comprehensive list of brand websites, categorized by their market position, style, and typical customer.

---

### 1. Industry Giants & High-End Ergonomics
These are the leaders in research, design, and ergonomics, commonly found in large corporate offices. They typically sell through authorized dealers but have increasingly robust online stores for individual buyers.

*   **MillerKnoll:** The parent company formed by the merger of two titans.
    *   **Herman Miller:** An icon of modern design and ergonomics. Famous for the Aeron, Embody, and Sayl chairs.
        *   **Website:** [www.hermanmiller.com](https://www.hermanmiller.com)
    *   **Knoll:** Renowned for its timeless, architecturally-inspired designs by figures like Mies van der Rohe and Eero Saarinen.
        *   **Website:** [www.knoll.com](https://www.knoll.com)

*   **Steelcase:** A global leader focused on creating great experiences at work. Known for their highly-rated Leap, Gesture, and Series 1 chairs.
    *   **Website:** [www.steelcase.com](https://www.steelcase.com)

*   **Haworth:** A major global player with a strong focus on design, innovation, and "organic workspaces." Known for the Fern and Zody chairs.
    *   **Website:** [www.haworth.com](https://www.haworth.com)

*   **Humanscale:** Specializes in high-performance ergonomic tools. They are famous for their minimalist and intuitive chairs like the Freedom, Diffrient World, and Liberty, as well as their monitor arms.
    *   **Website:** [www.humanscale.com](https://www.humanscale.com)

---

### 2. Modern & Direct-to-Consumer (DTC)
These brands are popular for home offices, startups, and small-to-medium businesses. They offer stylish, flexible furniture often at more accessible price points.

*   **UPLIFT Desk:** A leader in the direct-to-consumer standing desk market. Known for highly customizable and stable sit-stand desks and a huge array of accessories.
    *   **Website:** [www.upliftdesk.com](https://www.upliftdesk.com)

*   **Fully:** A pioneer in active and ergonomic office furniture, famous for the Jarvis Standing Desk. (Note: Fully was acquired by Herman Miller and is now being integrated into the main brand).
    *   **Website:** redirects to Herman Miller, but the products are still searchable.

*   **Branch:** Offers high-quality, affordable ergonomic furniture with a clean, modern aesthetic. Great for both home offices and furnishing entire offices for SMBs.
    *   **Website:** [www.branchfurniture.com](https://www.branchfurniture.com)

*   **Vari (formerly VariDesk):** Started with the famous desktop standing desk converter and has expanded into a full line of flexible office furniture, including full standing desks, chairs, and modular walls.
    *   **Website:** [www.vari.com](https://www.vari.com)

*   **Poppin:** Known for its bright, colorful, and modular "work-happy" designs. They offer everything from desks and chairs to a wide range of office accessories.
    *   **Website:** [www.poppin.com](https://www.poppin.com)

---

### 3. Mid-Market & Commercial Mainstays
These are solid, reliable brands often used in corporate, healthcare, and education settings. They offer a great balance of quality, design, and value.

*   **Allsteel:** A major manufacturer offering a comprehensive portfolio from systems furniture to seating. Part of the HNI corporation.
    *   **Website:** [www.allsteeloffice.com](https://www.allsteeloffice.com)

*   **Kimball International:** Provides a wide range of furniture for workplaces, health, and hospitality with a focus on craftsmanship.
    *   **Website:** [www.kimballinternational.com](https://www.kimballinternational.com)

*   **Teknion:** A Canadian-based international brand known for its design-forward approach and extensive product lines, including architectural interiors.
    *   **Website:** [www.teknion.com](https://www.teknion.com)

*   **Global Furniture Group:** Offers a very broad range of affordable and durable office furniture solutions for corporate, educational, and healthcare markets.
    *   **Website:** [www.globalfurnituregroup.com](https://www.globalfurnituregroup.com)

---

### 4. High-Design & European Brands
For those who see furniture as a statement piece. These brands are often specified by architects and interior designers for high-end projects.

*   **Vitra:** A Swiss family-owned company known for producing the works of iconic designers like Charles and Ray Eames, George Nelson, and Jean Prouvé for the European market.
    *   **Website:** [www.vitra.com](https://www.vitra.com)

*   **Kartell:** An Italian brand famous for its contemporary furniture made with innovative plastic materials. Their Componibili storage units and Louis Ghost chairs are iconic.
    *   **Website:** [www.kartell.com](https://www.kartell.com)

*   **USM:** A Swiss brand celebrated for its modular furniture system, USM Haller. It’s a timeless, customizable, and incredibly durable solution for both office and home.
    *   **Website:** [www.usm.com](https://www.usm.com)

---

### 5. Budget-Friendly & Retail Aggregators
These websites are excellent for individuals, home offices, and businesses on a tight budget. They offer a massive selection from various brands.

*   **IKEA:** The go-to for affordable, functional, Scandinavian-design furniture. Their desks, chairs (like the Markus), and storage (Kallax, Alex) are home office staples.
    *   **Website:** [www.ikea.com](https://www.ikea.com)

*   **Wayfair Professional:** The business-focused arm of Wayfair. It offers a huge selection of furniture at all price points, with services tailored to business customers.
    *   **Website:** [www.wayfair.com/professional](https://www.wayfair.com/professional)

*   **Staples:** A reliable source for basic office furniture, from budget-friendly chairs and desks to file cabinets and more.
    *   **Website:** [www.staples.com](https://www.staples.com)

*   **Office Depot / OfficeMax:** Similar to Staples, offering a wide range of practical and affordable office furniture solutions.
    *   **Website:** [www.officedepot.com](https://www.officedepot.com)
